intro: 这一章把前面“观察法”列方程的过程系统化：先用有向图和关联矩阵 A、基本回路矩阵 B_f、基本割集矩阵 Q_f 描述**拓扑**（KCL、KVL），再用支路矩阵 Y、Z 描述**元件**，两者相乘就得到结点、回路、割集方程——适合计算机列写大型电路。最重要的习惯：先定好每条支路的方向和电源符号，再做矩阵乘法。

ideas.title: 电路的图：结点、支路、树、连支
text: 把每条支路画成一条线段、每个结点画成一个点，就得到电路的**图**；给每条支路规定方向（就是支路电压、电流的关联参考方向）就是**有向图**。图只描述连接关系，与元件性质无关。
本章用**标准支路**（复合支路）：一个电阻/阻抗元件，可以串一个电压源、并一个电流源（或受控电流源），合起来算一条支路。支路内部的连接点不是图的结点。
**树**：连通全部 n 个结点、不含回路的支路集合，树支数总是 n − 1；其余 b − n + 1 条是**连支**。独立 KCL 方程 n − 1 个，独立 KVL 方程 b − n + 1 个，合起来正好 b 个。

en.title: The graph of a circuit: nodes, branches, trees, links
text: Draw each branch as a line and each node as a point: that is the **graph** of the circuit; give every branch a direction (the associated reference direction of its voltage and current) and it becomes a **directed graph**. The graph describes connections only, not element laws.

This chapter uses the **standard (composite) branch**: one resistor/impedance, possibly with a voltage source in series and a current source (or controlled current source) in parallel, counts as one branch. Points inside a branch are not nodes of the graph.

A **tree** connects all n nodes without a loop and always has n − 1 branches; the other b − n + 1 branches are **links**. There are n − 1 independent KCL and b − n + 1 independent KVL equations, b in total.

ideas.title: 割集与基本割集
text: **割集**是一组支路：把它们全部移去，图恰好分成两个分离部分；少移去其中任何一条，图仍连通。画法：一条闭合线，它穿过的支路就是割集支路。包围单个结点的割集就是该结点的全部支路。
割集形式的 KCL：穿出闭合面的支路电流代数和为零（规定一个方向为正）。
**基本割集**：每条树支确定一个，只含这一条树支、其余都是连支；方向取该树支的方向。基本割集共 n − 1 个，它们的 KCL 彼此独立。

en.title: Cut-sets and fundamental cut-sets
text: A **cut-set** is a set of branches whose removal splits the graph into exactly two parts, while removing all but any one of them leaves it connected. Draw it as a closed curve: the branches it crosses form the cut-set. Around a single node it is all branches at that node.
KCL for a cut-set: the algebraic sum of the branch currents crossing the closed surface (one way counted positive) is zero.
A **fundamental cut-set** is defined by each tree branch: it contains that one tree branch plus links, and takes its direction. There are n − 1 of them, with independent KCL equations.

ideas.title: 关联矩阵 A 与 KCL、KVL 的矩阵形式
text: **关联矩阵**：a_jk = +1（支路 k 离开结点 j）、−1（进入）、0（不相连）。完整的 A_a 每列恰有一个 +1 和一个 −1；删去参考结点那一行得到 (n − 1) × b 的**降阶关联矩阵 A**。
用 A 写拓扑约束：**KCL：A·I = 0**（第 j 行是结点 j 流出电流之和）；**KVL：V = Aᵀ·V_n**（每个支路电压等于起点与终点的结点电压之差）。

en.title: Incidence matrix A, KCL and KVL in matrix form
text: **Incidence matrix**: a_jk = +1 if branch k leaves node j, −1 if it enters, 0 otherwise. Each column of the full A_a holds exactly one +1 and one −1; deleting the reference row gives the (n − 1) × b **reduced incidence matrix A**.
Topological laws with A: **KCL: A·I = 0** (row j sums the currents leaving node j); **KVL: V = Aᵀ·V_n** (each branch voltage is the difference of its end node voltages).

ideas.title: 基本回路矩阵 B_f、基本割集矩阵 Q_f 及其关系
text: 选定一棵树。**B_f**：每条连支一行（它与树构成的基本回路，方向同连支），b_jk = ±1/0；KVL 写成 **B_f·V = 0**。**Q_f**：每条树支一行（基本割集，方向同树支）；KCL 写成 **Q_f·I = 0**。
支路按“先树支、后连支”排列时 B_f = [B_t  1_{l}]、Q_f = [1_{t}  Q_l]。回路与割集正交：**A·B_fᵀ = 0、Q_f·B_fᵀ = 0**，所以 **Q_l = −B_tᵀ**——写出一个，另一个不用再找。
连支电流就是回路电流：**I = B_fᵀ·I_l**；树支电压就是割集电压：**V = Q_fᵀ·V_t**。

en.title: Fundamental loop matrix B_f, cut-set matrix Q_f and their relations
text: Choose a tree. **B_f**: one row per link (its fundamental loop, directed like the link), entries ±1/0; KVL reads **B_f·V = 0**. **Q_f**: one row per tree branch (fundamental cut-set, directed like the branch); KCL reads **Q_f·I = 0**.

With the tree branches numbered first, B_f = [B_t  1_{l}] and Q_f = [1_{t}  Q_l]. Loops and cut-sets are orthogonal: **A·B_fᵀ = 0, Q_f·B_fᵀ = 0**, hence **Q_l = −B_tᵀ** — write one, and the other follows.
Link currents are the loop currents: **I = B_fᵀ·I_l**; tree-branch voltages are the cut-set voltages: **V = Q_fᵀ·V_t**.

ideas.title: 标准支路与支路矩阵 Y、Z（含受控源、互感）
text: 标准支路 k：**İ_k = Y_k(V̇_k + V̇_sk) − İ_sk**，即 **V̇_k = Z_k(İ_k + İ_sk) − V̇_sk**。符号：电压源“+”极在支路终点一侧（推动电流沿支路方向）时 V̇_sk 为正；电流源方向与支路方向**相反**时 İ_sk 为正。写成矩阵：I = Y(V + V_s) − I_s。
没有受控源和互感时 Y、Z 是对角阵。**受控电流源**在 Y 里加非对角元：支路 k 中的 g·V̇_ej（支路 j 无源元件的电压）→ Y_kj = ±g；β·İ_ej → Y 的第 k 行加上 ±β 倍的第 j 行（即 Y_kj = ±β·Y_j）。符号看受控源相对支路 k、控制量相对支路 j 的方向。
**互感**：Z_jk = Z_kj = ±jωM，两支路电流都从同名端流入（或都流出）时取 +；结点法用 Y = Z⁻¹（耦合部分求逆）。

en.title: Standard branch and the branch matrices Y, Z (controlled sources, coupling)
text: Standard branch k: **İ_k = Y_k(V̇_k + V̇_sk) − İ_sk**, i.e. **V̇_k = Z_k(İ_k + İ_sk) − V̇_sk**. Signs: V̇_sk is positive when the source's "+" faces the end of the branch (pushing current along it); İ_sk is positive when the current source points **against** the branch. In matrix form I = Y(V + V_s) − I_s.

Without controlled sources and coupling, Y and Z are diagonal. A **controlled current source** adds off-diagonal entries to Y: g·V̇_ej in branch k (V̇_ej = voltage of the passive element of branch j) → Y_kj = ±g; β·İ_ej → row k of Y gains ±β times row j (Y_kj = ±β·Y_j). The sign follows the source's direction relative to branch k and the controlling quantity's relative to branch j.
**Coupled inductors**: Z_jk = Z_kj = ±jωM, + when both branch currents enter (or both leave) the dotted ends; the node method uses Y = Z⁻¹ on the coupled block.

ideas.title: 结点电压方程的矩阵形式
text: 把 KCL（A·I = 0）、KVL（V = Aᵀ·V_n）和支路方程 I = Y(V + V_s) − I_s 合在一起：**A·Y·Aᵀ·V_n = A·I_s − A·Y·V_s**，即 Y_n·V_n = J_n。
Y_n 与“观察法”的结果一致：对角元为自导，非对角元为负的互导；右端是电源（诺顿等效）注入各结点的电流。没有受控源时 Y_n 对称；有受控源时一般**不对称**。
结点法要求每条支路都有有限的导纳：单独的电压源支路（无伴电压源）不能直接用。

en.title: Node equations in matrix form
text: Combining KCL (A·I = 0), KVL (V = Aᵀ·V_n) and the branch equations I = Y(V + V_s) − I_s gives **A·Y·Aᵀ·V_n = A·I_s − A·Y·V_s**, i.e. Y_n·V_n = J_n.

Y_n matches the inspection method: self-admittances on the diagonal, minus the mutual admittances off it; the right-hand side is the source current (Norton equivalent) into each node. Without controlled sources Y_n is symmetric; with them it generally is **not**.
Every branch needs a finite admittance: a voltage source alone in a branch cannot be handled directly.

ideas.title: 回路电流方程与割集电压方程
text: **回路法**：KVL B·V = 0、I = Bᵀ·I_l 和 V = Z(I + I_s) − V_s → **B·Z·Bᵀ·I_l = B·V_s − B·Z·I_s**。Z_l 的元素：自阻；两回路共有支路的阻抗，方向一致取正、相反取负；互感会耦合不共支路的回路。
**割集法**：KCL Q·I = 0、V = Qᵀ·V_t → **Q·Y·Qᵀ·V_t = Q·I_s − Q·Y·V_s**，未知量是树支电压。选“所有树支都接参考结点”的树时，它就是结点法。割集法的“互导”可以为正。

en.title: Loop and cut-set equations
text: **Loop method**: KVL B·V = 0, I = Bᵀ·I_l and V = Z(I + I_s) − V_s → **B·Z·Bᵀ·I_l = B·V_s − B·Z·I_s**. Entries of Z_l: self-impedances; impedances shared by two loops, + if both run the same way, − otherwise; mutual inductance can couple loops that share no branch.

**Cut-set method**: KCL Q·I = 0 and V = Qᵀ·V_t → **Q·Y·Qᵀ·V_t = Q·I_s − Q·Y·V_s**, with the tree-branch voltages as unknowns. With a tree whose branches all touch the reference node it is the node method. Mutual terms of the cut-set method may be positive.

ideas.title: 状态方程
text: 动态电路的**状态变量**取电容电压和电感电流，写成一阶方程组 **ẋ = A·x + B·z**（z 是独立源向量，Sadiku 的写法）。A 的特征值就是电路的固有频率。
**常态树**：电压源、电容全部进树，电流源、电感全部作连支，电阻补齐。对每个电容树支列基本割集的 KCL（得到 C·dv_C/dt），对每个电感连支列基本回路的 KVL（得到 L·di_L/dt），再消去电阻的电压、电流。
有纯电容（与电压源）回路或纯电感（与电流源）割集时，状态变量不独立，个数少于储能元件数。

en.title: State equations
text: The **state variables** of a dynamic circuit are the capacitor voltages and inductor currents, written as first-order equations **ẋ = A·x + B·z** (z = the independent sources, as in Sadiku). The eigenvalues of A are the natural frequencies.

**Proper tree**: all voltage sources and capacitors in the tree, all current sources and inductors as links, resistors to complete it. KCL of the fundamental cut-set of each capacitor tree branch gives C·dv_C/dt; KVL of the fundamental loop of each inductor link gives L·di_L/dt; then eliminate the resistor variables.
Loops of capacitors (and voltage sources) or cut-sets of inductors (and current sources) make the state variables dependent: fewer states than storage elements.

examples.title: 选一棵树，写出 A、B_f、Q_f 并互相核对
statement: 电路如图：V_s1 = 6 V，I_s5 = 1.5 A，R_1 = R_2 = 2 Ω，R_3 = R_4 = R_5 = 4 Ω。支路 1 = V_s1 串 R_1，支路 5 = R_5 并 I_s5，结点 4 为参考结点，支路方向见有向图。
选树 T = {1, 3, 4}，写出 A、B_f（每条连支一行）和 Q_f（每条树支一行），并验证 Q_l = −B_tᵀ。

results.ask: b_23（B_f 第 2 行、第 3 列）

en.title: Pick a tree, write A, B_f and Q_f, and check them against each other
statement: In the circuit V_s1 = 6 V, I_s5 = 1.5 A, R_1 = R_2 = 2 Ω, R_3 = R_4 = R_5 = 4 Ω. Branch 1 = V_s1 in series with R_1, branch 5 = R_5 in parallel with I_s5, node 4 is the reference, branch directions as in the graph.
Take the tree T = {1, 3, 4}. Write A, B_f (one row per link) and Q_f (one row per tree branch), and verify Q_l = −B_tᵀ.
steps: 1. **Count.** n = 4, b = 5: 3 tree branches (1, 3, 4) and b − n + 1 = 2 links (2, 5).

3. **B_f.** Link 2 (1→2) returns to 1 via tree branches 3 (2→4) and 1 (4→1): (1, 1, 1, 0, 0); link 5 (3→4) returns to 3 via tree branch 3 reversed (4→2) and tree branch 4 (2→3): (0, 0, −1, 1, 1). So b_23 = **−1**.

5. **Check.** The tree columns of B_f (b_{·1}, b_{·3}, b_{·4}) = (1, 0), (1, −1), (0, 1); negated and transposed they give the link columns of Q_f (q_{·2}, q_{·5}): (−1, 0), (−1, 1), (0, −1) ✓; A·B_fᵀ: the row of node 2, (0, −1, 1, 1, 0), dotted with (1, 1, 1, 0, 0) = −1 + 1 = 0 ✓.

examples.title: 结点方程的矩阵形式：A·Y·Aᵀ·V_n = A·I_s − A·Y·V_s
statement: 电路如图：V_s1 = 6 V，I_s5 = 1.5 A，R_1 = R_2 = 2 Ω，R_3 = R_4 = R_5 = 4 Ω。支路 1 = V_s1 串 R_1，支路 5 = R_5 并 I_s5，结点 4 为参考结点，支路方向见有向图。
按标准支路写出 Y、V_s、I_s，求 Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ、J_n = A·I_s − A·Y·V_s，解出结点电压和 I_4。

en.title: Node equations in matrix form: A·Y·Aᵀ·V_n = A·I_s − A·Y·V_s
statement: In the circuit V_s1 = 6 V, I_s5 = 1.5 A, R_1 = R_2 = 2 Ω, R_3 = R_4 = R_5 = 4 Ω. Branch 1 = V_s1 in series with R_1, branch 5 = R_5 in parallel with I_s5, node 4 is the reference, branch directions as in the graph.
Write Y, V_s and I_s for the standard branches, form Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ and J_n = A·I_s − A·Y·V_s, and solve for the node voltages and I_4.
steps: 1. **Branch quantities.** Y = diag(1/2, 1/2, 1/4, 1/4, 1/4) (S); the "+" of V_s1 faces node 1 (the end of branch 1), V_s = (6, 0, 0, 0, 0)ᵀ V; I_s5 points up, against branch 5 (3→4), I_s = (0, 0, 0, 0, 1.5)ᵀ A.

2. **Y_n = A·Y·Aᵀ** (A as in the previous example) = \mat{1 & −1/2 & 0 ; −1/2 & 1 & −1/4 ; 0 & −1/4 & 1/2}: Y_11 = **1 S**, Y_22 = **1 S**, Y_23 = **−0.25 S** — the self- and mutual admittances of the inspection method.
5. **Branch current.** I_4 = (V_n2 − V_n3)/R_4 = **−0.3 A** (it actually flows from 3 to 2). **Check** at node 3: I_s5 brings 1.5 A = 4.8/4 = 1.2 A out through R_5 + 0.3 A towards node 2 ✓.

mistakes.text: 把标准支路内部的连接点（电压源与电阻之间）当成结点，结点数、树支数都多算。先按“一个无源元件 + 串联电压源 + 并联电流源”合并支路，再数结点。

en.text: Counting the point inside a standard branch (between a source and its resistor) as a node, which inflates n and the tree size. Merge each passive element with its series voltage source and parallel current source first, then count nodes.

mistakes.text: 把“去掉后图不连通”的任何支路集合都当成割集。割集必须恰好分成两部分且是最少的：去掉后分成三部分、或者其中某条支路的两端在同一部分，都不是割集。

en.text: Calling any disconnecting set a cut-set. A cut-set splits the graph into exactly two parts and is minimal: three parts, or a branch with both ends on the same side, means it is not a cut-set.

mistakes.text: A 的符号反了：a_jk = +1 是支路**离开**结点 j。检查方法：完整的 A_a 每列一个 +1、一个 −1，各行相加为零。

en.text: Reversed signs in A: a_jk = +1 means the branch **leaves** node j. Check: each column of the full A_a has one +1 and one −1, and the rows add up to zero.

mistakes.text: 基本回路的方向随手取顺时针。教材约定基本回路方向取**连支方向**、基本割集方向取**树支方向**，所以 B_f、Q_f 中连支（树支）部分是单位矩阵。

en.text: Taking every fundamental loop clockwise. By convention a fundamental loop follows its **link** and a fundamental cut-set its **tree branch**, which is why B_f and Q_f contain identity blocks.

mistakes.text: V_s、I_s 的符号按电源“在图上朝哪边”判断。标准支路的约定是相对**支路方向**：电压源“+”朝支路终点为正，电流源**逆着**支路方向为正——和结点法右端“电流源流入结点为正”是同一回事。

en.text: Judging the signs of V_s and I_s by how the source is drawn. The convention is relative to the **branch direction**: a voltage source with "+" toward the branch end is positive, a current source pointing **against** the branch is positive — the same as "source current into a node is positive" in the node equations.

mistakes.text: 有受控源时仍把 Y_n 写成对称矩阵。受控项 Y_kj 只出现在受控源所在支路的行、控制量所在支路的列，乘上 A 以后 Y_n 一般不对称。

en.text: Writing a symmetric Y_n despite a controlled source. The controlled term sits in the row of the source's branch and the column of the controlling branch; after multiplying by A, Y_n is generally not symmetric.

mistakes.text: 互感项的符号按“两电感串联还是并联”判断。在支路阻抗矩阵里只看两条**支路方向**相对同名端：都流入（或都流出）同名端取 +jωM。回路之间的耦合再由 B 的符号决定。

en.text: Choosing the sign of the mutual term from how the inductors look connected. In the branch impedance matrix only the two **branch directions** relative to the dots matter: both into (or both out of) the dots → +jωM. The coupling between loops then follows from the signs in B.

mistakes.text: 列状态方程时把电感放进树、电容放成连支，结果电感电压、电容电流出现在方程里消不掉。常态树：电容、电压源进树，电感、电流源作连支。

en.text: Putting an inductor in the tree or a capacitor among the links when writing state equations, leaving inductor voltages or capacitor currents that cannot be eliminated. Proper tree: capacitors and voltage sources in the tree, inductors and current sources as links.

en.intro: This chapter systematises the inspection methods of earlier chapters: the directed graph with the incidence matrix A, the fundamental loop matrix B_f and the fundamental cut-set matrix Q_f describes the **topology** (KCL, KVL), the branch matrices Y, Z describe the **elements**, and their products give the node, loop and cut-set equations — the form a computer uses for large circuits. The key habit: fix every branch direction and source sign first, then multiply matrices.
